class AdoptionDecisionModule(ModuleBase):
    def forward(self, state, buffers, params, t):
        coeff = params.get("decision_coefficients", {})
        intercept = float(coeff.get("intercept", -0.5))
        b_sn = float(coeff.get("beta_social_norms", 1.2))
        b_pol = float(coeff.get("beta_policy", 0.9))
        b_risk = float(coeff.get("beta_risk_perception", 0.8))
        b_cost = float(coeff.get("beta_cost", -0.6))
        b_trust = float(coeff.get("beta_trust", 0.5))
        peer_norm = buffers.get("signals", {}).get("peer_norm", {})
        policy_signal = 1.0 if state["government"].mandate_active else 0.0
        avg_price = max(0.1, sum(r.price_per_mask for r in state["retailers"]) / max(1, len(state["retailers"])) )
        person_updates = {}
        intent = {}
        for p in state["persons"]:
            social = peer_norm.get(p.id, 0.0)
            risk = p.risk_perception
            trust = p.trust_in_authority
            # simple cost proxy: price relative to daily income budget
            budget = params.get("max_daily_mask_spend_fraction_income", 0.0005) * max(1.0, p.income / 365.0)
            rel_cost = min(1.0, avg_price / max(0.1, budget))
            z = intercept + b_sn*social + b_pol*policy_signal + b_risk*risk + b_cost*rel_cost + b_trust*trust
            p_wear = sigmoid(z)
            wear_today = (p.mask_inventory > 0) and (self.rng.random() < p_wear)
            person_updates[p.id] = {"adoption_state": 1 if wear_today else 0}
            intent[p.id] = wear_today or (p.mask_inventory < params.get("target_inventory", 5) and p_wear > 0.5)
        signals = buffers.get("signals", {})
        signals["intent_to_wear_mask"] = intent
        return {"person_updates": person_updates, "signals": signals, "location_updates": {}, "retailer_updates": {}, "global_updates": {}, "observables": {}, "io": {}}

def compute_summary_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    obs = self.observables
    series = obs.get("adoption_rate_daily", [])
    n = len(series)
    overall = sum(series) / n if n else 0.0
    t70 = next((i for i, v in enumerate(series) if v >= self.params.get("target_adoption_threshold", 0.7)), None)
    # media influence effect: corr-like diff using exposures averaged over day
    media_eff = obs.get("media_influence_effect", None)
    supply_eff_series = obs.get("supply_constraints_effect_daily", [])
    supply_eff = sum(supply_eff_series)/len(supply_eff_series) if supply_eff_series else 0.0

    return {"overall_adoption_rate": overall, "time_to_target_adoption": t70, "media_influence_effect": media_eff, "supply_constraints_effect": supply_eff}
